newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-ONE MAN TO TAKE HIS CHANCE IN GOLD CUP.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-ONE MAN TO TAKE HIS CHANCE IN GOLD CUP.

text.p: One Man, winner of the King
George VI Chase at Kempton for the last two years, looks set to take his chance in next month's Cheltenham Gold Cup.
There had been much speculation that the popular grey would miss the big race and be aimed instead at the Queen Mother Champion Chase, raced over a much shorter distance.
But, when entries for the two events were released on Wednesday, One Man's name appeared only among the Gold Cup candidates.
One Man started a short-priced favourite last year before coming home a tired sixth, raising doubts about his ability to handle the track and the distance.
Ireland, who won the race in 1996 with Imperial Call, have a particularly strong hand this year, headed by Imperial Call, defending his title, and potential champions Dorans Pride and Danoli
Latest betting: 7-2 Imperial Call, 5-1 Dorans Pride, 6-1 Danoli, 8-1 Coome Hill, 9-1 One Man, 10-1 Dublin Flyer, 12-1 and upwards others.
